summary: Andrew Gilsdorf, 23, successfully summited Mount Princeton but lost the trail in deep snow while descending into the trees; he stayed put and called dispatch. Chaffee County SAR North deployed a three-person snowshoe team (plus support staff), located him about a half-mile off the road using his cellphone GPS, and after rehydrating and feeding him guided him down the rest of the way.
notes: Date pinned to Thursday 2015-05-28 (weekday-verified; article asset date June 2, 2015; story notes unusual late-season snowfall and June high-country avalanche danger). Hiker was tired, dehydrated, and without food.
